notes.title: New Updates! Fake Customers Updates
notes.content:
📢 Patch Notes – Fake Customers Are Here!
Things just got trickier in Smuggler City Simulator!

With this update, fake customers can now walk into your office. They act like real buyers, but don’t be fooled—they might be testing you... Better think twice before making that deal.

🔍 What’s New?

🚶‍♂️ Fake Customer System Added – Spotting the difference is now part of the challenge

💼 Increased office traffic and more interaction options

🐞 Minor bug fixes and performance improvements

Business in Smuggler City just got riskier... good luck!

notes.title: Smuggler City Simulator Early Demo Hot Fix V0.3
notes.content:
🛠️ Major Update: Bargaining System Overhaul + New Sound Effects!
Hey everyone! 🎮

We’re excited to roll out a new update that brings major improvements to core systems along with fresh content for a more immersive gameplay experience.
[hr][/hr]🔊 New Sound Effects for a Livelier Experience!
We've added a variety of new sound effects to the buying and selling processes.

Expect to hear horns, customer reactions, and cash handling sounds during negotiations and transactions.

All audio is carefully balanced to match the atmosphere and enhance realism.
[hr][/hr]🤝 Bargaining System Reworked from the Ground Up
Customers now react to overpriced offers with surprise or even refusal.

Pricing decisions are now more realistic and dynamic.

The chances of a successful bargain now depend on how close your offer is to the buyer's expected price range.
[hr][/hr]🐞 Bug Fixes & System Improvements
Fixed an issue where customers would accept absurdly high prices.

Resolved bugs related to the sales panel, inventory updates, and price mismatches.

Performance optimizations for smoother gameplay.
[hr][/hr]📌 Coming Soon
New customer animations

Expanded inventory features

Regional economic mechanics
[hr][/hr]
Your feedback keeps the game growing – don’t hesitate to share your thoughts in the Steam discussions! 💬
Happy trading and good luck making those big sales! 🤑📱

– Reylor Games
